name: Find a shared interest
short_description: Elicit each side's stated position and identify one underlying interest they share.
self_assessment: I can identify one shared interest in a two-person disagreement without help.
description: Elicit each side's stated position and identify one underlying interest they share. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
